Hi Roger and James
In your recent chat with Patrick Tomasso at TIFF you mentioned recently timing Shawshank. Was this for the steelbook Blu Ray that was released last year for the 30th anniversary?
I’d like to obtain a copy with your most recent transfer and colour work.
Many thanks
Adam
